parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives under 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits inside an Examples/SampleApp subtree. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where a record resides under Examples/ or SampleApp/ is treated as a sample-app-mirror and warrants no-action. Merging or consolidating the production type-alias in DebugPanel with the sample-app type-alias in WallpaperSampleApp would couple production semantics to demonstration code.
